invariants.rationale: The method parseRegionName(name) is called, which will throw a NullPointerException if name is null. Thus, name should not be null at method entry.
It is likely that empty names are not valid image identifiers; parsing and region lookup would expect a valid, non-empty string.
The returned region name from parseRegionName(name) must be non-null for atlas.findRegion to work correctly.
A valid region name should not be empty to enable atlas.findRegion(regionName) to return meaningful results.
